correctness.rationale: The proof explicitly handles every n>=1 and every A,B subset W. Incomparable E- and F-cells give A=E[w],B=F[w] as a counterexample to meet preservation, whereas nested cells force equality S=D. The incidence star criterion follows from one partition block containing the other, and the join components are unique. Each size-m component has precisely 2B_m-1 ordered structures; exponential formula and recurrence are established. Unlabelled component types are counted by 2p(m)-1, producing the ordinary product. Inclusion-exclusion counts globally comparable pairs and the 4-world minimal obstruction. The direct checker tests all labelled pairs through n=6, all truth-set meets through n=4, orbit counts through n=5; it returned ALL_CHECKS_OK. Finite experiments support but do not replace symbolic proof.

value.rationale: The quantification of a natural two-agent S5 semantics is exact for every finite carrier: both labelled frames and simultaneous-relabelled types are enumerated, with an optimal four-world divergence between local and global informational dominance. It is not merely a reworded normality test or an arbitrary finite coefficient: it provides closed generating functions and a sharp natural threshold that clarify when nonnormal group knowledge collapses to distributed knowledge.
